# Public workspace

Read the task instruction supplied by the harness. Implement submission/main.py
using Python 3.11 standard-library modules only. This workspace has no runtime
network requirement.

Run the small example with:

```
python3 -I /work/submission/main.py < /work/examples/diamond.json
```

Compare JSON semantically with examples/diamond.expected.json. For ambiguous
classes, any two distinct candidate paths are valid witnesses. No private
reference or verifier is included here.
===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replace this starter with a self-contained evidence replay implementation."""
import json
import sys

if __name__ == "__main__":
    json.load(sys.stdin)
    print(json.dumps({"error": "not-implemented"}))
    raise SystemExit(1)
